preconditions.description: The first line of input is a single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2·10^5), representing the number of bracket types and half the number of cards.
The input contains exactly 2n + 1 lines: one for n and 2n lines for the cards.
Each of the 2n card lines contains exactly two integers separated by whitespace.

preconditions.expression: all(-int(n) <= int(x) <= int(n) and int(x) != 0 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for x in line.split())
preconditions.description: Each card's front and back numbers are integers in [-n, n] excluding 0.

preconditions.expression: all(abs(int(x)) <= int(n) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for x in line.split())
preconditions.description: Each card's front and back numbers are in the range [-n, n] (absolute value ≤ n).

preconditions.expression: set(int(x) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for x in line.split()) == {*range(-int(n), int(n) + 1)} - {0}
preconditions.description: Every integer in [-n, n] excluding 0 appears exactly twice in the entire input (once as front and once as back).

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() == 'YES') == (any(all(balanced_sequence(fronts), balanced_sequence(backs)) for fronts, backs in permutations(cards)))
postconditions.description: If there exists a permutation of the cards such that both the sequence of front numbers and the sequence of back numbers are balanced bracket sequences, output 'YES' followed by the permutation. Otherwise, output 'NO'.
If 'YES', the output must include exactly 2n lines of card pairs after the 'YES' line, matching the input format.

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() == 'YES') == (any(all(balanced_sequence([card[0] for card in permutation]), balanced_sequence([card[1] for card in permutation])) for permutation in permutations(cards)))
postconditions.description: The output permutation must satisfy that both the front sequence (all first elements of the permutation) and the back sequence (all second elements of the permutation) are balanced bracket sequences.
